items.name: Identity Document: Vermin Black
items.description: A folded identity document found on the floor of the waking room. Name: Vermin Black. The photograph confirms your own emotionless visage.

items.name: Brass Field Lantern
items.description: A sturdy brass lantern found beside a dead projector. It burns with steady warmth, casting away unnatural gloom.

items.name: Plain-Killing Elixir
items.description: The expensive plain-killing elixir Vermin routinely drinks when in pain. It deadens bodily ache and numbs sensory shock.

items.name: Full Medication Bottle
items.description: An intact, sealed pharmaceutical bottle with a handwritten prescription: Take as needed. Cease asking why.

items.name: Journal Page: Bella & Braxton
items.description: A blood-spotted handwritten diary entry detailing how Vermin butchered his family dogs in the upstairs bathtub with his father's shaving blade to make a point.

items.name: Journal Page: The Waiting Room Complaint
items.description: Vermin's personal account of tricking a distressed father seeking a missed ride complaint into signing an involuntary mental commitment form.

items.name: Journal Page: Post-Play Cleanliness
items.description: Vermin's methodical notes detailing how to stuff spilled viscera back into a corpse's abdomen and bind the limbs and torso with intestines.

items.name: Rattling Music Box
items.description: A brass-filigreed music box that rattled without unwinding. A fire-ember cloud vanished the instant its lid snapped shut.

items.name: Unlabelled 35mm Film Reel
items.description: A heavy canister of celluloid film discovered upon the kitchen table. Its frames depict shifting doorways, empty tables, and flashing numerals.

items.name: Clinical Straight Razor
items.description: A surgical-grade folding straight razor with a scarred bone handle. It balances perfectly in a calm hand.

items.name: Numbered Iron Key (A)
items.description: A heavy blackened iron key stamped with the letter A. It unlocks the reinforced access door at the end of the first looping corridor.

items.name: Numbered Iron Key (B)
items.description: An iron key stamped with the letter B, retrieved from beneath a coil of cold organic matter.

items.name: Numbered Iron Key (C)
items.description: An iron key stamped with the letter C, recovered from the kitchen storage cupboard.

items.name: Father's Shaving Blade
items.description: A vintage straight edge retrieved from the mirrored bathroom cabinet. Memories of crimson ceramic and childhood resolve cling to the steel.

items.name: Sterile Bandage Cloth
items.description: Clean medical cloth suitable for staunching cuts and binding bruised joints.

items.name: Involuntary Commitment Document
items.description: A legal intake document signed under false pretenses. The signature at the bottom is jagged, grateful, and completely doomed.

items.name: Void-Tempered Lantern
items.description: The brass lantern fitted with clarity crystal facets. Its beam pierces spectral veils and exposes entity camouflage.

items.name: The Key to the Verdict
items.description: An archaic key forged from cold black alloy. It materialized after the final countdown numeral extinguished.

items.name: Clinical Case File #001
items.description: A clinical intake folder recording patient observations. Notes describe a subject whose emotional responses were deliberately dismantled.

items.name: Patient File: The Delayed Father
items.description: Case notes for the man who missed his daughter's birth: Subject repeatedly stated he was of sound mind; bell rang; attendants summoned.

items.name: Empty Laboratory Vial
items.description: A stoppered glass vial intended for mixing chemical reagents or compounding sedatives.

items.name: Ash Dust Vial
items.description: Pungent grey residue swept up from the wake of an extinguished ember cloud.

items.name: Void Crystal Shard
items.description: A dark crystalline stone that hums at an inaudible frequency, bending room reflections around its vertices.

items.name: Rusted Autopsy Hook
items.description: A heavy, curved iron hook originally intended for hoisting carcasses and securing heavy anatomical specimens.

items.name: Stained Laboratory Trenchcoat
items.description: A thick leather-lined clinical trenchcoat that shields against airborne toxic mists and slashing claws.

items.name: Compounded Clarity Tonic
items.description: An improvised chemical formulation that instantly clears clouded vision and settles unsteady balance.

items.name: Entity Ward Talisman
items.description: A tightly bound knot of entity cloth surrounding a core of void crystal. Entities hesitate before approaching it.

items.name: Void Ash
items.description: Fine, weightless grey powder gathered where popped lights and fading apparitions collapse.

items.name: Glass Shard
items.description: Jagged shards of popped incandescent bulbs and shattered medicine vials.

items.name: Void Resin
items.description: Congealed dark sap scraped from doorframes that refuse to open.

items.name: Entity Cloth
items.description: A tattered scrap of coarse fabric that retains residual levitation and a toxic chill.

items.name: Blood-Tempered Iron
items.description: Dense iron recovered from surgical tables and bathtub drainage pipes, dark with dried hemoglobin.

items.name: Clarity Crystal
items.description: A crystalline prism formed by intense focal thought amidst overwhelming sensory distortion.

items.name: Entity Ash Dust
items.description: Fine grey particulate residue left behind by dissolved apparitions.
